what: Bo asks for the open seat. Ada signs one batch holding a confirm of the open seat whose holder is 15 bytes, a confirm of Bo in it, and her move e4 (A). A holder is an author id, 16 bytes, and a confirm naming anything else names nobody and counts for nothing: Bo holds the open seat, the seat is not void, e4 is admitted, and nothing is reported (confirms). Before, a schema CHECK threw on the short holder inside the merge; read as a holder, it would have voided the seat as a second holder and reported Ada AUTHOR_EQUIVOCATED.
